answer.rationale: Run a tightly targeted, time-bounded price intervention only for price-sensitive SMB accounts showing active churn risk; do not broadly match the competitor’s cut. The recovered discount experiment produced acquisition and qualified-revenue gains but a 12% 30-day retention decline, so broad discounting conflicts with the sustainable qualified-revenue objective. Existing-customer save-offer performance remains uncertain, requiring strict eligibility, expiry, and cohort-level retention/revenue guardrails.
